# Codex review — OpenAI Codex CLI code review with GPT-5.2-Codex and CI/CD integration

Curated by Skill Harbor — 💳 Paid API required: this skill requires OpenAI API access (billed usage) or a ChatGPT subscription to run Codex — no usable free tier for headless/CI use. @alinaqi's codex-review skill: a complete playbook for code review with OpenAI's Codex CLI and GPT-5.2-Codex — install and authenticate (API key or ChatGPT sign-in), run interactive review presets (/review: base-branch diff, uncommitted changes, single commit, custom instructions), automate with headless mode (JSON output, output schemas, sandbox read-only, drop-sudo), and integrate into GitHub Actions (@codex review PR comments), GitLab CI, and Jenkins.
